message.reasoning_content: We need to list crimes directly supported by the fact: On March 11 2014, defendant Ke beat a bartender suspected of reporting his drug use. After the incident, medical appraisal says the victim's injury did not reach the standard (i.e., no injury). So the assault did not cause injury meeting legal standard. In Chinese criminal law, assault without causing injury may be "故意伤害罪" requires injury; if no injury, maybe "非法拘禁"? No. Could be "寻衅滋事罪" (picking quarrel and provoking trouble) for causing public disorder? The fact: He used fists to beat someone, but no injury. That could be "故意伤害罪" if injury is not reached, maybe "轻伤"? Not. Could be "侮辱罪"? No. Could be "非法侵入"? No. The act is assault (打人) but no injury. Under Chinese law, "故意伤害罪" requires causing bodily injury; if no injury, maybe "非法拘禁"? Not. There's "聚众斗殴罪"? No. "寻衅滋事罪" includes "随意殴打他人" causing minor injuries? Actually "寻衅滋事罪" includes "随意殴打他人" causing轻伤? Let's recall: Article 293 of Criminal Law: "寻衅滋事罪" includes (1)随意殴打他人，情节轻微的; (2)追逐、拦截、辱骂他人，情节轻微的; etc. So beating someone without causing injury could be "寻衅滋事罪". Also could be "故意伤害罪" if injury not reaching standard maybe still considered "轻伤"? But they said "未达鉴定标准", meaning no injury. So not "故意伤害". So the appropriate charge is "寻衅滋事罪". Also possibly "非法拘禁"? No. So answer: [罪名]寻衅滋事罪<eoa>
